title: OneEEG: A Unified Signal-Visual Multimodal Language Model with Task-Aware Mixture of Projectors for Multi-Task EEG Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.35355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is widely used in clinical assessment, brain-computer interfaces, and cognitive-state analysis, yet EEG modeling remains fragmented across task paradigms. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a promising interface for flexible multimodal reasoning, but their ability to understand EEG inputs remains limited. In this work, we propose OneEEG, a unified EEG-MLLM framework for multi-task EEG understanding. By training on our curated OneEEG-Instruct, a multi-task EEG instruction-tuning dataset, OneEEG jointly models numerical EEG representations and visual EEG representations, and introduces a task-aware Mixture of Projectors (MoP) to align heterogeneous EEG features across different task families with the LLM embedding space. translated_title: OneEEG：一种具有任务感知投影器混合机制的统一信号-视觉多模态语言模型，用于多任务脑电图理解
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）广泛应用于临床评估、脑机接口和认知状态分析，然而脑电图建模在不同的任务范式之间仍然处于碎片化状态。近期出现的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）为灵活的多模态推理提供了有前景的接口，但其理解脑电图输入的能力仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了OneEEG，一个用于多任务脑电图理解的统一脑电图-多模态大语言模型框架。通过在我们精心构建的OneEEG-Instruct（一个多任务脑电图指令微调数据集）上进行训练，OneEEG联合建模数值型脑电图表示和视觉型脑电图表示，并引入任务感知的投影器混合机制，将不同任务族中的异构脑电图特征与大语言模型的嵌入空间进行对齐。我们进一步建立了OneEEG-Bench，一个用于评估当前多模态大语言模型及我们方法在多任务脑电图理解上表现的基准。实验表明，现有的多模态大语言模型能力有限……
tldr: OneEEG提出了一个统一的脑电图多模态大语言模型框架，通过多任务指令微调数据集联合建模数值与视觉两种脑电图表示，并借助任务感知的投影器混合机制将异构脑电图特征对齐到大语言模型嵌入空间，从而实现多任务脑电图理解。
en_tdlr: OneEEG presents a unified EEG-multimodal LLM framework that jointly models numerical and visual EEG representations via a curated multi-task instruction-tuning dataset, employing a task-aware Mixture of Projectors to align heterogeneous EEG features with the LLM embedding space for multi-task EEG understanding.
